rules: Require the exact IA commdrza00ursi identity and all eight pinned retained-envelope member hashes.

Require the candidate primary-source authority set to equal the five retained_files bound by the acquisition sidecar; bind receipt, metadata, inventory, and reconstruction dependencies as support authorities.
Independently account for 720 PDF/OCR pages, 722 scandata leaves, the two explicitly excluded color cards, 16 empty OCR pages, all ordered paragraphs and lines, and 436 source-derived contents rows.
Require one TEI root, one text element, and one body division for the single source-titled commentary represented by duplicate manifest rows L427 and L468.
Reconcile every TEI page, line, paragraph, contents row, and diagram link to independent source-derived expectations; verify every external facsimile URI resolves to the retained scan.pdf bytes.
Validate the TEI against the bound TEI P5 XSD and Relax NG schemas and the source-accountability document against its bound JSON Schema.

Preserve OCR readings and list unreviewed OCR and diagram concerns as unresolved; do not infer missing text or convert technical validation into human acceptance, rights clearance, or publication authorization.
Require current declared work, state, edition, and acquisition sidecars to bind the candidate source; reproduce package and validation bytes from fresh processes.

unresolved_fidelity_gaps.statement: Provider OCR spelling and transcription have not been comprehensively proofread against the retained scan. Preserve OCR readings without silent correction.
unresolved_fidelity_gaps.disposition: Candidate preserves the source OCR and page/paragraph/line order; visual collation remains open.

unresolved_fidelity_gaps.statement: The scan-linked diagram carriers and transcribed brace hierarchy are present, but every printed label and branch relationship has not received complete visual and semantic proofreading.
unresolved_fidelity_gaps.disposition: Retain the scanned figures and the current source-linked hierarchy as a nonaccepted candidate; keep proofreading open.
